tasks.task: I’m cleaning up my support queue before end of day. Please sign me in, find my open ticket titled "Cannot login" (it reports the login page returning 500), mark it resolved with the note "Issue no longer reproducible after retry; closing out before EOD", then close it. Finally, confirm the ticket is closed.

success_criteria: Authentication succeeds and the session user is alice.
The ticket selected from the user’s tickets has title "Cannot login" and id 1.
resolve_ticket returns success for ticket id 1.
close_ticket returns success for ticket id 1.

args.resolution: Issue no longer reproducible after retry; closing out before EOD

tasks.task: I need to clean up my open support queue before end of day. Please log me into the ticketing system, find my ticket titled "Cannot login" (it should be open), mark it as resolved with the note "Issue no longer reproducible; login works after cache clear", then close it and confirm it is no longer Open.

success_criteria: ticket_login returns authenticated=true for username alice
get_user_tickets returns a ticket with title "Cannot login" and provides its id
resolve_ticket succeeds for that ticket id with the provided resolution text
close_ticket reports the ticket has been closed successfully for that same id
get_ticket for that id shows status is not "Open" (ideally "Closed")

args.resolution: Issue no longer reproducible; login works after cache clear

tasks.task: I need to make sure only one ticket remains open about the login outage before our 5pm triage cutoff. Please log in as alice, find my open ticket titled "Cannot login" (it reports the login page returns 500), resolve it with a short note that the issue was fixed after retrying, then close it, and finally confirm the ticket’s final status is Closed.

success_criteria: Step 2 returns an open ticket with title "Cannot login" and an id that is used in steps 3–5.
Step 3 returns a success message indicating the ticket was resolved.
Step 4 returns a success message indicating the ticket was closed.
Step 5 returns the ticket record for that id with status equal to "Closed".

args.resolution: Issue no longer reproduces; after retrying the login request it succeeded and the outage appears resolved.
